extraction.name: MATH Dataset
extraction.description: A dataset of 12,500 challenging competition mathematics problems with step-by-step solutions, along with a large auxiliary pretraining dataset (AMPS) of Khan Academy and Mathematica problems.
extraction.creator: Dan Hendrycks, Collin Bums, Saurav Kadavath, Akul Arora, Steven Basart, Eric Tang, Dawn Song, Jacob Steinhardt
extraction.publisher: 35th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2021)
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Problems from mathematics competitions including the AMC 10, AMC 12, AIME, and more were collected from aops.com/community/c3158_usa_contests. The AMPS pretraining dataset was collected from Khan Academy and generated using Mathematica scripts.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Mathematics competitions including the AMC 10, AMC 12, AIME, and more from aops.com/community/c3158_usa_contests, Khan Academy exercises, and problems generated from manually designed Mathematica scripts.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Final boxed answers are forced to follow consistent formatting rules: probabilities are expressed as simplified fractions, matrix entry fractions are encoded with x/y, other fractions with \frac{x}{y}, coefficients without a multiplication symbol, expressions with multiple variables in alphabetical order, and polynomials in decreasing degree order.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Problems and solutions are consistently formatted using LATEX and the Asymptote vector graphics language. Final answers are wrapped and delimited with the \boxed{} command.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Problems are tagged by difficulty from 1 to 5, and span seven subjects. Each problem has a step-by-step solution and a final boxed answer.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The authors note they do not intend for this dataset to train models that help students cheat on mathematics exams, but rather to better forecast reasoning capabilities.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking mathematical problem-solving ability, pretraining, fine-tuning, and testing machine learning models. Intended to better forecast reasoning capabilities.
